use.flag: Enable Ceph RBD and CephFS storage backends (pulls sys-cluster/ceph, dev-perl/librados2-perl)
Enable VMware ESXi import storage plugin

pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Proxmox VE storage management library. Provides the unified storage abstraction layer (PVE::Storage) with plugins for all supported backends: Directory, LVM, LVM-thin, NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI, RBD (Ceph), CephFS, ZFS, ZFS-on-root, BTRFS, Proxmox Backup Server (PBS), and ESXi import.
All plugin .pm files are always installed (PVE::Storage hard-uses all plugins at startup). USE flags control only the system-level tools needed to actually use each backend.
Note: libpve-cluster-perl (not yet ported) is required to read /etc/pve/storage.cfg. Single-node workaround: seed the file manually.
